def transform(grid):

    # the upper-right figure; the matching color-1 example is retained.

    upper = _objects(grid, set(range(sep)))
    lower = _objects(grid, set(range(sep + 1, len(grid))))
    template = next(obj for obj in lower if obj[0][2] == 1)
    piece = max(upper, key=lambda obj: max(x for _, x, _ in obj))

    top = min(y for y, _, _ in indicator)

    top_count = sum(y == top for y, _, _ in indicator)
    bottom_count = sum(y == bottom for y, _, _ in indicator)
    points_up = top_count < bottom_count

    py_min = min(y for y, _, _ in piece)
